sentences.text:
Author: Surepalli Nanda
Bench: Surepalli Nanda
 Hon'Ble Mrs Justice Surepalli Nanda
 Writ Petition No.13817 Of 2023
Order:

Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing on behalf of respondent Nos.1 to 4 and Sri P.Harinatha Gupta, learned standing counsel appearing on behalf of 5th respondent.

2. It is the specific case of the petitioners that the petitioners vide their application dated 02.08.2022 addressed to the 3rd respondent expressed the petitioners grievances for referring the matter to the appropriate forum for determination of the correct market value of the subject properties to the extent of Ac 0.725Cts., in Sy.No.112/D2, Ac 0.625Cts., in Sy.No.112/B1 and Ac 1.40Cts., in Sy.No.112/A, respectively situated at Jadadoddi Village, Ieeja Mandal, Jogulamba Gadwal District, which had been acquired for construction of six-lane access controlled Greenfield highway section from KN/TS border to bank of Thungabhadra River near Budamarsu Village as part of Solapur-Kurnool-Chennai WP_13817_2023 SN,J Greenfield economic corridor on Hybrid Annuit Mode under Bharatmala Pariyojana in the state of Telangana Act 1956. But however an incorrect market value is paid and compensation had been fixed.
The grievances of the petitioners are that the amount fixed is not the reasonable amount and the petitioners without accepting the award received the awarded amount under protest.

Therefore, the petitioners submitted individual applications dated 02.08.2022, requesting the 3rd respondent to refer the matter to the appropriate forum for determination of the correct market value of the subject properties, and all the said three applications had been acknowledged on 08.08.2022 by the office of the 3rd respondent but however, no action has been initiated till as on date.

3. It has been agreed by both the counsel that the writ petition could be disposed of directing the 3rd and 5th respondents to consider the petitioners applications dated 02.08.2022 which had been acknowledged by the 3rd respondent on 08.08.2022 and initiate appropriate necessary action within a reasonable period.

WP_13817_2023 SN,J 4. Taking into consideration the above referred submissions, the writ petition is disposed of directing the 3rd respondent to consider the petitioners applications dated 02.08.2022 in accordance to law and take appropriate decision in the matter referring the subject issue to an Telugu Narsimulu vs The State Of Telangana on 6 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13696363/
1 appropriate forum for determination of the correct market value of the agricultural lands of the petitioners for an extent of Ac.0.725 cts, in Survey No.112/D2, Ac.0.625 cts, in Survey No.112/B1,
and Ac.1.40 cts in 112/F respectively situated at Jadadoddi Village, Ieeja Mandal, Jogulamba Gadwal District within a period of three (03) weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
However, there shall be no order as to costs.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Writ Petition, shall stand closed.

MRS JUSTICE SUREPALLI NANDA Date:06.06.2023 Kgk Telugu Narsimulu vs The State Of Telangana on 6 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13696363/
